title: Golden benchmark cost cases test a local aggregation implementation
reasoning: The cost test calls a helper that independently computes missing-cost detection, total cost, denominators, and benchmark averages before constructing BenchmarkScore. It therefore verifies test-local arithmetic rather than production aggregation. A production regression that converts a produced checkpoint's missing cost to zero can escape this golden scenario.
reproduction: A change to production calculate_scores cost handling cannot affect this test because it never calls that function.
recommendation: Build ProblemScoreInput and BenchmarkScoreInput from these golden cases and obtain the actual result through calculate_scores. Keep the fixture values as independent expected outputs.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Included production aggregation tests cover raw rounding and unproduced zero-cost checkpoints, but the explicit produced-with-missing-cost golden case uses only the local helper.
suggestedRegressionTest: Route the existing parameterized cost scenarios through production aggregation and assert null propagation, zero contribution from unproduced checkpoints, and the configured checkpoint denominator.
minimumFixScope: Golden aggregation scenarios in scoring_models_test.py; retain the helper only where constructing ranking inputs is intentional.
